services.name: Online Reputation Management Services
services.headline: Online Reputation Management Services
services.summary: Need a clear plan for online reviews, customer feedback and your brand reputation?
services.body: DMB helps businesses manage how they respond to customer reviews and present accurate information online. We review your public profiles, agree the platforms and brand mentions to monitor, and build a practical response process for positive and negative feedback. Online reputation management (ORM) connects review management, brand reputation monitoring and customer follow-up. We help your team explain concerns professionally, escalate sensitive complaints and keep business details consistent. Where a review appears to violate a platform’s rules, we can help document the concern and use its reporting process. Platforms decide whether a review is removed; we do not promise removal or improved ratings.
services.fit: Service businesses, clinics, hotels, travel companies, property businesses and growing brands that need a consistent way to handle public feedback.
deliverables: Review of agreed business profiles, reviews and public brand mentions
Monitoring plan for agreed platforms, keywords and review frequency
Response guidelines and drafts for positive, neutral and negative reviews
Complaint escalation workflow and customer follow-up recommendations
Genuine customer review request process without fabricated reviews or selective requests for positive ratings
Monthly reputation summary with feedback themes and agreed next steps
services.inputs: Your website, public profile links, platforms to cover, examples of customer feedback and a team contact who can approve responses and investigate complaints.
services.measure: We review response times, unanswered reviews, recurring customer concerns and completed follow-up actions. Rating trends and review sentiment provide context; we do not guarantee a rating, rankings or review removal.

faq.q: What is included in online reputation management?
faq.a: The agreed scope can include profile reviews, monitoring public feedback and brand mentions, drafting review responses, complaint escalation and reporting. We confirm platforms, monitoring frequency and approval responsibilities before starting.

faq.q: Can you remove negative Google reviews?
faq.a: We can help assess and report reviews that appear to violate the platform’s policies. Google makes the removal decision. A negative opinion alone does not guarantee removal, and we cannot delete another person’s review.

faq.q: Do you create reviews or guarantee five-star ratings?
faq.a: No. We support requests for genuine customer feedback and clear responses. We do not create fake reviews, guarantee ratings or offer rewards for favourable reviews.

faq.q: Will you publish responses without our approval?
faq.a: We agree an approval process first. Responses involving disputed facts, personal information or sensitive complaints are escalated to your team before publication.

faq.q: How much do ORM services cost?
faq.a: Pricing depends on the number of profiles, platforms, review volume and monitoring frequency. Share your requirements and we will explain the work, fee and timeline.

services.metaDescription: Manage online reviews, brand mentions and customer feedback with DMB’s ORM services. Get a clear response process and reputation management plan.
